steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction with a valid auction configuration.
Select the available auction pricing template so the product sheet can be populated.
Add the specified product as the single line item.
Choose the specified Plant Name delivery location.
Confirm the requested location was applied before checking the generated title.
